region.name: the Rookmoor
region.blurb: Green farmland in the west, high mountain passes and misty bogs in the middle, and in the east the besieged walls of Larkbury.

towns.name: Brightbridge
towns.blurb: The royal city of the Rookmoor: white walls, red roofs, and a castle flying the Queen's banners.

mayor.name: Baron Mo
mayor.title: Baron
mayor.avatar: white-haired, twinkling-eyed baron with a red beard braided with beads, a mustard-yellow waistcoat, and a lapdog under one arm
greeting: Welcome to Brightbridge, Hero! The Queen's messenger said you would come.
Anything you need, ask. The Queen's champion is welcome everywhere in Brightbridge.

quest.title: The Brass Spyglass
offer: The harbour master's spyglass is missing, and nobody can see the ships coming in.
A gull took it. It was last seen flying toward Eaglefell. Bring it back and you'll have my thanks, and a reward besides.
quest.reminder: Any sign of the Brass Spyglass? A gull took it. It was last seen flying toward Eaglefell.
done: The spyglass! Now we can watch for ships again.
Here is your reward, and well earned.

shop.name: The Golden Sheaf

keeper.name: Marigold
keeper.avatar: brisk shopkeeper with a pencil behind one ear and a ledger under one arm

lines: Fresh bread, fresh draughts, fresh advice. What'll it be?

workshop.name: Olwen's Workshop

keeper.name: Olwen
keeper.avatar: glassblower with goggles pushed up into her curls

lines: Anvil, cauldron, grindstone: use what you like. Pedal hard and it all goes faster!

npcs.name: Cedric
npcs.avatar: freckled child with a wooden sword and a helmet three sizes too big
lines: When I grow up, I'm going to be a hero too!
One-Eyed Jack prowls the road between Miremarsh and Brightbridge.

gives.line: Are you a real hero? Mum says heroes always carry healing draughts. Here, take one of mine!

npcs.name: Smith Pip
npcs.avatar: muscular smith with soot-streaked arms and a leather apron
lines: Hammer and anvil, all day long. Look at these arms!
I can build up yours too, for a fee.
The Mossy Kettle in Ashglen sells a Bulwark Shield. It costs a fortune: 240 gold.

npcs.name: Fisher Hale
npcs.avatar: weathered fisher in oilskins, with a net over one shoulder
lines: A quiet net and a calm sea. That's all I ask.
The Golden Sheaf in Brightbridge sells silk ribbon.

npcs.name: Peddler Barnaby
npcs.avatar: round peddler under a huge pack hung with pots and trinkets
lines: I walk every road in the Rookmoor. Most of them twice.
The Brass Spyglass from Brightbridge is hidden in the Bell Tower in Eaglefell.

spots.name: the Bell Tower
spots.text: Up among the bells, in a pigeon's nest: a Traveler's Tonic!

towns.name: Larkbury
towns.blurb: A walled border town under siege. Smoke rises from the fields beyond the walls.

mayor.name: Earl Bram
mayor.title: Earl
mayor.avatar: elegant earl with a neat white beard, a fur-trimmed mantle, and a lapdog under one arm
greeting: Hero! You made it through the lines! The Queen heard us.
General Vorn camps beyond the walls with a whole legion. We have food for a week, maybe two.

shop.name: The Last Candle

keeper.name: Sparrow
keeper.avatar: cheerful cook-turned-shopkeeper in a flour-dusted apron

lines: Everyone else has gone, but somebody has to sell the potions.

workshop.name: The Cracked Anvil

keeper.name: Bryony
keeper.avatar: glassblower with goggles pushed up into her curls

lines: Everyone else has fled. The anvil's all yours.

npcs.name: Grandpa Wystan
npcs.avatar: white-bearded grandfather on a bench, with a walking stick across his knees
lines: I've lived in Larkbury for eighty years, and I'm not leaving now.
The Northwind Spear, the Bulwark Shield and the Queen's Banner. The old songs say you need all three.

npcs.name: Watchman Agatha
npcs.avatar: exhausted young watchman in a battered helmet, holding a bucket
lines: I've been on this wall for six days. My feet have forgotten what a bed is.
Every morning they shout that we should surrender. Every morning we shout back something rude.

spots.name: the Ruined Hall
spots.text: In the rubble of the old hall you find a Greater Healing Draught, somehow unbroken.

towns.name: Silverpeak
towns.blurb: A mining town behind thick stone walls. Hammers ring from every tunnel.

mayor.name: Mayor Godfrey
mayor.title: Mayor
mayor.avatar: broad mayor with a bald head that shines, a long blue coat with silver buttons, and a wheat-sheaf brooch
greeting: Silverpeak welcomes you, Hero. We have heard all about you.
Silverpeak stands firm, and so do its people.

quest.title: Old Boulderback
offer: Old Boulderback has been prowling the road to Mistmoor, frightening every traveller. Nobody dares to use that road any more.
Beat Old Boulderback, and I'll make it worth your while.
quest.reminder: Old Boulderback is still out on the road to Mistmoor.
done: Old Boulderback beaten? Then Silverpeak owes you a great deal.
Here is your reward, and well earned.

shop.name: The Iron Anvil

keeper.name: Robin
keeper.avatar: quick-talking trader with curly hair and a ledger under one arm

lines: Steel for heroes. Only the best, and the best isn't cheap.

workshop.name: The Stonecutter's Yard

keeper.name: Bertram
keeper.avatar: broad smith in a scorched leather apron, with forearms like hams

lines: Dwarves built this forge. It has never once gone cold.

npcs.name: Baker Rowan
npcs.avatar: round, rosy baker in a floury apron, with a tray of buns
lines: My pies are famous as far as Mistmoor. Well, as far as the end of the street.
Only a Bulwark Shield can turn General Vorn's fire. The Mossy Kettle in Ashglen has one.

npcs.name: Lem
npcs.avatar: cheerful minstrel in a feathered cap, with a fiddle under one arm
lines: I'm writing a song about you! So far it's mostly about your boots.
The Harvest Cup from Ashglen is hidden in the Old Chapel in Silverpeak.

spots.name: the Old Chapel
spots.text: Behind the altar, in a dusty niche: the Harvest Cup.

towns.name: Ashglen
towns.blurb: A woodcutters' village in a clearing, where the sawmill hums and the air smells of pine.

mayor.name: Mayor Fenwick
mayor.title: Mayor
mayor.avatar: plump, cheerful mayor with a magnificent moustache, a sea-green robe, and a very large hat
greeting: Ah, the Queen's champion! Welcome to Ashglen.

quest.title: The Harvest Cup
offer: The Harvest Cup has vanished from the hall, and the fair is next week!
The folk of Silverpeak won it last year and never got over losing it. I bet it's there. Bring it back and I'll make it worth your while.
quest.reminder: Any sign of the Harvest Cup? The folk of Silverpeak won it last year and never got over losing it. I bet it's there.
done: The Harvest Cup! Just in time for the fair.
Here is your reward, and well earned.

shop.name: The Mossy Kettle

keeper.name: Theobald
keeper.avatar: soot-faced armourer with a thick moustache and a hammer on his belt

lines: Bows, cloaks, and forest remedies. All handmade.

workshop.name: Crispin's Woodshop

keeper.name: Crispin
keeper.avatar: broad smith in a scorched leather apron, with forearms like hams

lines: The grindstone sings when you pedal fast. Make it sing!

npcs.name: Nell
npcs.avatar: broad woodcutter in a checked shirt, with a long axe and sawdust everywhere
lines: Hear that? A woodpecker. Or a goblin with a hammer. Hard to say.
There is an eagle feather hidden in the Snowman in Whitehold.

npcs.name: Granny Linnea
npcs.avatar: tiny, kindly witch in a mossy shawl, with a toad sitting on her hat
lines: Nettle soup for strength, willow tea for aches. Nothing for goblins, sadly.
The Harvest Cup from Ashglen is hidden in the Old Chapel in Silverpeak.

npcs.name: Rue
npcs.avatar: small child with scabby knees and a pet frog in one pocket
lines: Can I hold your sword? Just for a second? Please?
The Weather Rooster from Eaglefell is hidden in the Hollow Oak in Ashglen.

spots.name: the Hollow Oak
spots.text: Deep inside the hollow oak, among old acorns and junk, something glints: the Weather Rooster!

towns.name: Whitehold
towns.blurb: Terraces of snowy roofs climb the mountainside, joined by steep, icy stairs.

mayor.name: Baroness Coralie
mayor.title: Baroness
mayor.avatar: stout baroness with a long golden plait, a patched but proud coat, and a lapdog under one arm
greeting: Whitehold welcomes you, Hero. We have heard all about you.
Keep your mittens on. Frostbite is no joke.

quest.title: A Basket of Kittens for Eaglefell
offer: Would you carry this basket of kittens to Lord Jasper in Eaglefell? Our cat had kittens again, and I hear they have mice.
They pay their couriers well, I promise.
quest.reminder: Lord Jasper in Eaglefell is waiting for the basket of kittens.
done: Kittens! Oh, look at them. The mice had better watch out.

shop.name: The Frosted Kettle

keeper.name: Leofric
keeper.avatar: soot-faced armourer with a thick moustache and a hammer on his belt

lines: Shut the door! You're letting the winter in.

workshop.name: The Frost Forge

keeper.name: Una
keeper.avatar: glassblower with goggles pushed up into her curls

lines: The warmest room in town! Pedal and you'll soon forget the cold.

npcs.name: Juniper the Wise
npcs.avatar: small, round wizard in a patchwork robe covered in singe marks, with spectacles on a chain
lines: Ooh, I could do wonders with you. New hair? New cloak?
Magic is cheap. Well, sixty gold. That is cheap, for magic.
The Golden Sheaf in Brightbridge sells silk ribbon.

npcs.name: Old Blair
npcs.avatar: bright-eyed village elder with a knobbly stick and a patchwork cloak
lines: Mind the road to Miremarsh. It has a mind of its own.
The Mill Gear from Mistmoor is hidden in the Old Chapel in Whitehold.

npcs.name: Baker Sven
npcs.avatar: round, rosy baker in a floury apron, with a tray of buns
lines: Heroes need feeding. You look like you skipped breakfast.
The quickest road to Larkbury is the one from Eaglefell.

spots.name: the Snowman
spots.text: Inside the snowman, right where its heart would be: an eagle feather!

spots.name: the Old Chapel
spots.text: Behind the altar, in a dusty niche: the Mill Gear.

towns.name: Eaglefell
towns.blurb: A town of goatherds and stonecutters, stacked up a steep and windy slope.

mayor.name: Lord Jasper
mayor.title: Lord
mayor.avatar: small, brisk lord with a neat white beard, a long blue coat with silver buttons, and a tawny owl on one shoulder
greeting: A hero, in Eaglefell! Come in, come in, mind the step.
Eaglefell stands firm, and so do its people.

quest.title: The Weather Rooster
offer: The weather rooster blew off the steeple in the last storm.
The wind was blowing toward Ashglen. It must have landed there. Bring it back and I'll make it worth your while.
quest.reminder: Any sign of the Weather Rooster? The wind was blowing toward Ashglen. It must have landed there.
done: Our rooster! Back up on the steeple it goes.

shop.name: The Deep Delve

keeper.name: Poppy
keeper.avatar: freckled shopkeeper in a patchwork apron, with a cat asleep on the counter

lines: Steel for heroes. Only the best, and the best isn't cheap.

workshop.name: The High Forge

keeper.name: Dunstan
keeper.avatar: bearded woodworker with curls of shavings stuck to his jumper

lines: Dwarves built this forge. It has never once gone cold.

npcs.name: Hunter Ivy
npcs.avatar: weathered hunter in green leather, with a hawk on one wrist
lines: Out here, the tough get through and the rest go home.
A few coins, and I'll make you as tough as old roots.
There is an eagle feather hidden in the Snowman in Whitehold.

npcs.name: Wendel
npcs.avatar: shepherd in a thick wool cloak, with a crook and a sheepdog at heel
lines: Four hundred sheep, and I know every one by name.
The Brass Spyglass from Brightbridge is hidden in the Bell Tower in Eaglefell.

npcs.name: Ottilie
npcs.avatar: small child with scabby knees and a pet frog in one pocket
lines: When I grow up, I'm going to be a hero too!
The Weather Rooster from Eaglefell is hidden in the Hollow Oak in Ashglen.

npcs.name: Guide Percival
npcs.avatar: wiry mountain guide with a coil of rope and wind-burned cheeks
lines: From here the road to Whitehold climbs, and keeps on climbing.
The Old Chest in Eaglefell is locked. Its key was lost in the Old Boathouse in Miremarsh years ago.

spots.name: the Bell Tower
spots.text: Up among the bells, in a pigeon's nest: the Brass Spyglass!

spots.name: the Old Chest
spots.text: The Rusty Key turns with a screech. Inside the old chest: a Tome of Might!
spots.lockedText: A heavy chest sits in the corner, locked tight. The keyhole is caked with rust.

towns.name: Miremarsh
towns.blurb: Lantern-lit walkways wind between the houses over dark, still water. Frogs sing all night.

mayor.name: Baroness Rowena
mayor.title: Baroness
mayor.avatar: plump, cheerful baroness with dark curls, a fur-trimmed mantle, and a gold chain of office
greeting: Miremarsh welcomes you, Hero. We have heard all about you.
Forgive the smell; it is the bog.

quest.title: One-Eyed Jack
offer: One-Eyed Jack has been prowling the road to Brightbridge, frightening every traveller. Even the bravest carters turn back.
Beat One-Eyed Jack, and the Northwind Spear, which has hung in my hall for a hundred years, is yours.
quest.reminder: One-Eyed Jack is still out on the road to Brightbridge.
done: One-Eyed Jack beaten? Then Miremarsh owes you a great deal.
As promised: the Northwind Spear. May it serve you well against General Vorn.

shop.name: Jory's Curios

keeper.name: Jory
keeper.avatar: red-haired ex-sailor with a tattooed forearm and a gold earring

lines: Mind the jars. Some of them bite.

workshop.name: The Bog-Iron Forge

keeper.name: Constance
keeper.avatar: red-haired carpenter with a pencil behind her ear and sawdust in her hair

lines: Stir clockwise. Always clockwise. Trust me.

npcs.name: Ivor
npcs.avatar: lean ferry-keeper in a wide hat, leaning on a long pole
lines: I take anyone across. Except goblins. Goblins don't tip.
The Iron Legion comes from the hot south. They hate the cold.

npcs.name: Old Toby
npcs.avatar: white-bearded grandfather on a bench, with a walking stick across his knees
lines: Back in my day the roads were safe. Mostly. Sometimes.
Go on, Hero. Show them what Miremarsh is made of.

spots.name: the Old Boathouse
spots.text: Floating in the flooded boathouse: a Rusty Key!

towns.name: Mistmoor
towns.blurb: Lantern-lit walkways wind between the houses over dark, still water. Frogs sing all night.

mayor.name: Mayor Zinnia
mayor.title: Mayor
mayor.avatar: plump, cheerful mayor with a long golden plait, a sea-green robe, and a wheat-sheaf brooch
greeting: Ah, the Queen's champion! Welcome to Mistmoor.
Forgive the smell; it is the bog.

quest.title: The Mill Gear
offer: The mill has stopped. A gear is missing, and without it we can't grind a thing.
The miller's boy says a troll took it to Whitehold to wear as a hat. Bring it back and I'll make it worth your while.
quest.reminder: Any sign of the Mill Gear? The miller's boy says a troll took it to Whitehold to wear as a hat.
done: The gear! The mill will be turning again by supper.

shop.name: The Bubbling Pot

keeper.name: Sage
keeper.avatar: cheerful cook-turned-shopkeeper in a flour-dusted apron

lines: Mind the jars. Some of them bite.

workshop.name: The Bubbling Cauldron

keeper.name: Ellis
keeper.avatar: patient glassblower with singed sleeves and careful hands

lines: The cauldron never stops bubbling. Put something good in it.

npcs.name: Scholar Tilly
npcs.avatar: young scholar with ink-stained fingers and round spectacles
lines: Potions obey those who understand them.
I can teach you, for a modest fee.
Old Boulderback prowls the road between Silverpeak and Mistmoor.

npcs.name: Granny Rosalind
npcs.avatar: tiny, kindly witch in a mossy shawl, with a toad sitting on her hat
lines: Not all witches are wicked, dearie.
The Mill Gear from Mistmoor is hidden in the Old Chapel in Whitehold.

spots.name: the Old Chapel
spots.text: Behind the altar, in a dusty niche: a Healing Draught.

enemies.name: Goblin Scout
enemies.taunt: A goblin cackles and waves a rusty knife.

enemies.name: Giant Toad
enemies.taunt: A toad the size of a barrel blinks at you, then flicks out a very long tongue.

enemies.name: Bog Lurker
enemies.taunt: Something scaly rises from the muck.

enemies.name: Stone Troll
enemies.taunt: A troll steps out from behind a boulder. No, wait: the boulder IS the troll.

enemies.name: Rock Golem
enemies.taunt: A boulder unfolds into a grinding, rumbling golem.

enemies.name: Frost Wolf
enemies.taunt: A wolf as white as the snowfield pads closer, its breath freezing in the air.

enemies.name: Frost Sprite
enemies.taunt: A shivering sprite hurls a snowball. It is mostly ice.

enemies.name: Grey Wolf
enemies.taunt: A wolf slinks out of the grass, teeth bared.

enemies.name: Wild Boar
enemies.taunt: A boar paws the ground and snorts.

enemies.name: Angry Swan
enemies.taunt: A swan spreads its wings and hisses like a kettle. It wants the whole road to itself.

enemies.name: Giant Spider
enemies.taunt: A spider as big as a pony drops from the branches on a silver thread.

enemies.name: White Bear
enemies.taunt: A white bear lumbers out of the snow. It looks hungry, and a bit annoyed.

enemies.name: Cave Bats
enemies.taunt: A swarm of bats pours out of the rocks!

enemies.name: Mountain Eagle
enemies.taunt: An eagle with wings as wide as a cart dives out of the sun.

enemies.name: Legion Spearman
enemies.taunt: "Halt! This road belongs to the Iron Legion now."

enemies.name: War Hound
enemies.taunt: A huge hound in a spiked collar bounds toward you, barking.

enemies.name: Road Bandit
enemies.taunt: "Your gold or your life, traveler!"

enemies.name: Marsh Wisp
enemies.taunt: A pale light drifts closer, whispering your name.

enemies.name: One-Eyed Jack
enemies.taunt: "One-Eyed Jack, at your service. Now hand over everything shiny."
enemies.avatar: lanky bandit chief with an eyepatch, a feathered hat and far too many daggers

enemies.name: Old Boulderback
enemies.taunt: "Old Boulderback says: nobody crosses my pass."
enemies.avatar: moss-covered mountain troll with a back like a boulder and pebbles for eyes

enemies.name: General Vorn
enemies.taunt: "Surrender, and I may let you carry my baggage."
enemies.avatar: giant of a soldier in plate armour, with a war-hammer as tall as a man

hints.text: Baroness Rowena of Miremarsh keeps the Northwind Spear, and has promised it to whoever defeats One-Eyed Jack.
One-Eyed Jack prowls the road between Miremarsh and Brightbridge.
The Mossy Kettle in Ashglen sells a Bulwark Shield. It costs a fortune: 240 gold.
Only a Bulwark Shield can turn General Vorn's fire. The Mossy Kettle in Ashglen has one.
The Queen's Banner can't be bought or found: it has to be made, at the workshop in any town, from two lengths of silk ribbon and an eagle feather. It takes a few minutes of hard pedaling.
The Golden Sheaf in Brightbridge sells silk ribbon.
There is an eagle feather hidden in the Snowman in Whitehold.
The Brass Spyglass from Brightbridge is hidden in the Bell Tower in Eaglefell.
Old Boulderback prowls the road between Silverpeak and Mistmoor.
The Harvest Cup from Ashglen is hidden in the Old Chapel in Silverpeak.
The Weather Rooster from Eaglefell is hidden in the Hollow Oak in Ashglen.
The Mill Gear from Mistmoor is hidden in the Old Chapel in Whitehold.
The Old Chest in Eaglefell is locked. Its key was lost in the Old Boathouse in Miremarsh years ago.
To defeat General Vorn you need the Northwind Spear, the Bulwark Shield and the Queen's Banner.
The Iron Legion comes from the hot south. They hate the cold.
The quickest road to Larkbury is the one from Eaglefell.

challenge.title: The Iron Legion
summons: Ah, Hero, you came! Sit, please. I am afraid the news is bad.
General Vorn has marched the Iron Legion over our eastern border and laid siege to Larkbury. The town walls will not hold for long.
Our scholars say three things can bring General Vorn down: the Northwind Spear of the old kings, a Bulwark Shield against fire arrows, and my own banner, lost in the last war, to rally the people.
Find all three, then face General Vorn at the Siege Lines. Ask everyone you meet; the people of the Rookmoor know more than they think.
Here is gold for the road, and a few draughts. My carriage waits to take you to Brightbridge. Go with my blessing.

lair.name: the Siege Lines
lair.text: Rows of black tents, a forest of spears, and in the middle a great striped pavilion.

victory: You raise the Queen's Banner over the walls of Larkbury, and every soldier in the town cheers.
The Northwind Spear howls like a winter wind. The Iron Legion breaks and runs for the border.
The siege is over. General Vorn signs a peace treaty with a very shaky hand and marches home.
